Type: implementation or qualification task
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: O01.2
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend/operations engineer
Pilot scope: required

Scope: Supply a minimal supported deployment profile for staging and later pilot operation.
Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: O01 (bd-01M4W40K19EDEPHZA7Y20F340Z)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Validate database/storage/port/proxy/secret settings before serving; omit secrets from errors and ordinary process diagnostics.
2. Provide loopback/proxy or equivalent protected-origin configuration, TLS termination guidance, filesystem ownership and process supervision.
3. Graceful shutdown stops new work, drains or safely checkpoints bounded in-flight work and leaves leases recoverable after forced termination.

Verification: Clean-host configuration matrix and terminate/restart smoke tests under the deployment profile.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/O01.2/receipt.json
Evidence must include: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input.

Starting code/evidence:
- modules/app/src/main/scala/sanctity/app/ApiServer.scala
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresDatabase.scala
- build.sbt

Blocked by:
- O01.1: bd-01M4W5P7HBS1087HA1EX9MC0P2

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; create blocking remediation work for discovered scope. Automated or simulated evidence cannot replace a required institutional or human result. No implementation is claimed by this plan.
